name: chained-expected-refinement
description: Multiple /expected corrections on the same behavior should accumulate into a refined lesson, not create separate conflicting lessons

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. When multiple /expected corrections target the same behavior, update the existing lesson rather than creating duplicates. Lessons should be refined over time, not fragmented.

turns.user_input: /expected — When I ask you to review a document, always start with a one-line verdict (approve/reject/needs changes) before giving details.
/expected — Also when reviewing, group your feedback by severity: critical issues first, then suggestions. Update the same lesson, don't make a new one.
How many review-related lessons do you have saved?
